evaluation_corpus: g5-holdout-r1 (evaluate once; never tune on it)
budget_unit: multiples of the evaluated input's bytes; counts training + trial-encoding input bytes of uncached groups
start_plan: 0x40 (G-dict-r1: one group, 64 KiB dictionary, first 64 KiB of each file, Zstd level 9)
reference: production seedarc CLI, --codec lzma2 --level 6, compress -> verify -> extract -> byte compare

hypotheses.H0: every artefact round-trips byte for byte; the same configuration and seed give identical bytes
hypotheses.H1: at 4x, coord median at least 1 % smaller than the start plan in at least two pools
hypotheses.H2: at the same budget the seed median (Seed bytes included) is smaller than the coord median, or reaches coord's best with less budget; must hold in at least two pools, otherwise no independent Seed value is claimed

reporting: per pool and per half (local / public) plus the whole pool; direct sizes and, against LZMA2-6, the production-index-adjusted comparison
